depth_targets.title: Guest OS access (SSH, serial console, screenshot, OS info)
depth_targets.current_reason: No guest OS boots behind an instance, so there is nothing to SSH into, no serial console output, no screenshot preview and no OS Info (guest attributes).

depth_targets.title: Observability, recommendations and VM Manager
depth_targets.current_reason: Vyomi's monitoring/logging core only charts metrics explicitly written to it — there's no request-metering engine tying a VM's real CPU/disk/network state to time series, so the Monitoring/Logging tabs would have nothing real to plot (the same boundary as gcp.storage.observability). Recommender suggestions are AI-generated insights Vyomi does not generate. VM Manager (Patch, OS policies, VM Extens
